title: Fix accessibility toggles that apply no styles
description: data-optical="false" does not match the html[data-optical] selector so high-contrast rules never activate; only very high data-atmosphere values apply. 2 of the 4 accessibility controls in 3D have no visible effect.

classification.rationale: Classified as SIMPLE complexity. Direct delegation: single domain, no cross-cutting impact. Required agents (4): backend, frontend, qa, memory_engineer.
